name: Loading Indicator
structurePatterns: circular spinner rendered as a rotating partial ring (SVG circle with stroke-dasharray)
inline = 20px used inside buttons/inputs; section = 24px with optional label; page = 24px centered with label over a content block
spinner uses brand color on a subtle track; rotation ~0.8s linear
honors prefers-reduced-motion (show static ring or no rotation)
usageHints: use for indeterminate work; use Progress Indicator for determinate values
preserve usable content during background refresh when possible
long cancellable work needs an explicit cancel path
busy state must be announced for accessibility
